1.web: I am the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
1.asv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

2.web: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
2.asv: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

3.web: Surely against me he turns his hand again and again all the day.
3.asv: Surely against me he turneth his hand again and again all the day.

4.web: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.
4.asv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

5.web: He has built against me, and surrounded me with gall and travail.
5.asv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

6.web: He has made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
6.asv: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

7.web: He has walled me about, that I can’t go out; he has made my chain heavy.
7.asv: He hath walled me about, that I cannot go forth; he hath made my chain heavy.

8.web: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
8.asv: Yea, when I cry, and call for help, he shutteth out my prayer.

9.web: He has walled up my ways with cut stone; he has made my paths crooked.
9.asv: He hath walled up my ways with hewn stone; he hath made my paths crooked.

10.web: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
10.asv: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

11.web: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he has made me desolate.
11.asv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.

12.web: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
12.asv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

13.web: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
13.asv: He hath caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my reins.

14.web: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.
14.asv: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.

15.web: He has filled me with bitterness, he has sated me with wormwood.
15.asv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath sated me with wormwood.

16.web: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he has covered me with ashes.
16.asv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he hath covered me with ashes.

17.web: You have removed my soul far off from peace; I forgot prosperity.
17.asv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace; I forgat prosperity.

18.web: I said, My strength is perished, and my expectation from Yahweh.
18.asv: And I said, My strength is perished, and mine expectation from Jehovah.

19.web: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
19.asv: Remember mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

20.web: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
20.asv: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is bowed down within me.

21.web: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.
21.asv: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.

22.web: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
22.asv: It is of Jehovah’s lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

23.web: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
23.asv: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.

24.web: Yahweh is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
24.asv: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

25.web: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.
25.asv: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

26.web: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
26.asv: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Jehovah.

27.web: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
27.asv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

28.web: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
28.asv: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he hath laid it upon him.

29.web: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.
29.asv: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

30.web: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him; let him be filled full with reproach.
30.asv: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him; let him be filled full with reproach.

31.web: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
31.asv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever.

32.web: For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
32.asv: For though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

33.web: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
33.asv: For he doth not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

34.web: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
34.asv: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

35.web: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
35.asv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

36.web: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
36.asv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

37.web: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
37.asv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

38.web: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
38.asv: Out of the mouth of the Most High cometh there not evil and good?

39.web: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
39.asv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

40.web: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
40.asv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.

41.web: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
41.asv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

42.web: We have transgressed and have rebelled; you have not pardoned.
42.asv: We have transgressed and have rebelled; thou hast not pardoned.

43.web: You have covered with anger and pursued us; you have killed, you have not pitied.
43.asv: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

44.web: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
44.asv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

45.web: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.
45.asv: Thou hast made us an offscouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

46.web: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
46.asv: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

47.web: Fear and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.
47.asv: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and destruction.

48.web: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
48.asv: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

49.web: My eye pours down, and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
49.asv: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

50.web: Until Yahweh look down, and see from heaven.
50.asv: Till Jehovah look down, and behold from heaven.

51.web: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
51.asv: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

52.web: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
52.asv: They have chased me sore like a bird, they that are mine enemies without cause.

53.web: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
53.asv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone upon me.

54.web: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.
54.asv: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

55.web: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
55.asv: I called upon thy name, O Jehovah, out of the lowest dungeon.

56.web: You heard my voice; don’t hide your ear at my breathing, at my cry.
56.asv: Thou heardest my voice; hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

57.web: You drew near in the day that I called on you; you said, Don’t be afraid.
57.asv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.

58.web: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.
58.asv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

59.web: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
59.asv: O Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.

60.web: You have seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.
60.asv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.

61.web: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their devices against me,
61.asv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, and all their devices against me,

62.web: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
62.asv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

63.web: You see their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.
63.asv: Behold thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

64.web: You will render to them a recompense, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.
64.asv: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands.

65.web: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
65.asv: Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, thy curse unto them.

66.web: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
66.asv: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.
